# Message URI key parsing keeps protocol-specific hash and suffix boundaries

The IMAP parser bounds its last-hash search before an appended imap:// segment and ends the key at /?&. The mailbox parser uses the first hash and ?&. Removing MsgFindCharInSet only directs these calls to their string receivers; it does not unify those protocol contracts or validate every suffix/key. Folder-prefix changes and key conversion remain separate steps. No parser or protocol test ran.

Scope: IMAP and mailbox message URI parsing.
